verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State documents its own delegated-access mechanism, User Access, which lets an entity control who may submit online filings on its behalf, and it will be required for Statement of Information filings from August 1, 2026. The evidence does not publish the detailed rules of what a third party may or may not do. missing for 10: published authorization forms for granting third-party access, defined role names and permission scopes, rules on which signatures or attestations must remain personal to an officer, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal

citations.quote: User Access allows the entity to control who is authorized to submit online filings on behalf of the entity.
Effective August 1, 2026, web User Access is required for Statement of Information filings.
Establishing User Access will help in preventing unauthorized submissions or filings on your entity's record.
